column1: # Footprint row modules — one line per recursor arm with a footprint sibling.
# these rows plus the per-family templates and per-arm proof fragments in the generator.
#   arm       lower-camel arm name; the module is `Eval<Arm capitalised>RowFootprint`
#   family    int | intPilot | unary | logicalShort | logicalFall (template + fragment set)
#   result    the arm's result value form, as written in the emitted statements
#   resid     the cell's residual record (`int`/`intPilot` only; `-` otherwise)
#   guard     semantic guards of the cell contract, `name=prop` separated by `;` (`-` = none)
#   guardfn   the `BinIntCell` guard function the supplier consumes (`-` outside `int`)
#   guardpf   the term discharging that guard in the supplier (`-` outside `int`)
#   cell      the cell footprint (`<op>CellFoot`; `intCellFoot`-shaped unless noted)
#   shared    the shared cell footprint in `ExitFootprint.lean` this cell is
#             cell half of `<arm>NodeFoot_noArena`.  `-` = the arm shares a node
#   node      the node footprint used by the row's `EvalExitF`
#   box       the boxing helper whose write set closes the cell footprint
#   supplier  the emitted `EvalIHF noArenaFoot` supplier (`-` = none in this module)
#   extras    per-arm extras: `int` = the residual fields consumed (incl. libgcc `Loaded`
#             facts); other families = the arm's entry-extras structure
